'''Diego Golombek''' (born 22 November 1964) is an [[Argentine]] [[biologist]], [[Science communicator|communicator]] and [[Popular science|popularizer]] of [[science]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Diego Golombek|url=http://www.fundacionkonex.org/b2917-diego-golombek|publisher=Fundación Konex|accessdate=5 March 2014}}</ref> He is currently professor at [[National University of Quilmes]] and researcher at [[CONICET]]. He is author of several books about [[biology]] and related topics, although he is mainly known due to his appearances on [[radio]] and [[television]].

==Life==
He graduated from [[University of Buenos Aires]] in 1988 with a [[magna cum laude]] degree. Four years later, he obtained a [[PhD]] in biology at the same institution. In parallel with his biology career and still in his young years Golombek started to write [[short stories]] and [[poetry]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Diego Golombek|url=http://www.sigloxxieditores.com.ar/fichaAutor.php?idAutor=976|publisher=Siglo Veintiuno Editores|accessdate=5 March 2014}}</ref> He was awarded several literary prizes in [[Argentina]], [[Chile]] and [[Venezuela]].

==Work==
Golombek is an experienced researcher in [[chronobiology]]. In 2007 he received the [[Ig Nobel Prize]] for discovering that [[hamsters]] recover from [[jetlag]] more quickly under the effects of [[Viagra]].<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Agostino | first1 = P. V. | last2 = Plano | first2 = S. A. | last3 = Golombek | first3 = D. A. | title = Sildenafil accelerates reentrainment of circadian rhythms after advancing light schedules | journal = Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences | volume = 104 | pages = 9834–9 | year = 2007 | doi = 10.1073/pnas.0703388104| pmid=17519328| issue=23| pmc=1887561|bibcode = 2007PNAS..104.9834A | doi-access = free }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Plano | first1 = S. | last2 = Agostino | first2 = P. | last3 = Golombek | first3 = D. | title = Extracellular nitric oxide signaling in the hamster biological clock | journal = FEBS Letters | volume = 581 | issue = 28 | pages = 5500–5504 | year = 2007 | pmid = 17991439 | doi = 10.1016/j.febslet.2007.10.058| doi-access = free | bibcode = 2007FEBSL.581.5500P }}</ref> He is known for his aim of making biology understandable for laymen; his efforts are mostly intended to make public some aspects of scientists' everyday life, which are usually considered to be hidden or enigmatic. He insists that science is a fundamental resource for increasing the socio-economic activity of an [[underdeveloped]] country like Argentina.<ref>{{cite web|last=Castro|first=Verónica|title=Diego Golombek: "Desacralizar a la ciencia como una actividad de mártires y de sabios"|url=http://www.educ.ar/sitios/educar/recursos/ver?id=120605&referente=|publisher=educ.ar|accessdate=6 March 2014|year=2004}}</ref>

He has taken part in ''Científicos Industria Argentina'' ([[English language|English]]: Scientists Made in Argentina), a TV show hosted by [[mathematician]] [[Adrián Paenza]] and broadcast by [[TV Pública Digital (Argentina)|TV Pública]]. Golombek also hosts his own show in the same channel, which is named ''Doctor G''. It is a children-oriented show, in which he—along with his assistants, ''Sir from Here'' and ''Sir from There''—explains the science behind everyday tasks, such as what are the chemical procedures involved in cooking an [[asado]] or how a [[match]] works.<ref>{{cite web|title=Proyecto G|url=http://www.encuentro.gov.ar/sitios/encuentro/programas/ver?rec_id=50756|publisher=Encuentro|accessdate=9 March 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=El mundo del Doctor G|url=http://www.revistaplanetario.com.ar/news/view/el-mundo-del-doctor-g|publisher=Revista Planetario|accessdate=9 March 2014}}</ref>

Moreover, he is editor-in-chief of a collection called "''Ciencia que ladra...''", printed by ''Siglo Veintiuno''. Its name is a mention to the [[Spanish language|Spanish]] version of the [[proverb]] "its bark is worse than its bite", but in reference to science.

==Politics==
In 2016 Golombek became part of a Macri administration think tank which purported to be a "Presidential Council," but he left immediately after the first meeting.<ref>{{cite web|title=El Gobierno creó por decreto su equipo de intelectuales, pero aclaró: "No somos Carta Abierta"|url=http://www.politicargentina.com/notas/201611/17789-el-gobierno-creo-por-decreto-su-equipo-de-intelectuales-pero-aclaro-no-somos-carta-abierta.html|publisher=Política Argentina|accessdate=23 June 2018}}</ref>

In the wake of 2018 abortion debate in Argentina, he endorsed its legalization arguing that "a group of living cells does not represent a human being".<ref>{{cite web|title=Aborto legal: experto en divulgación científica afirma que "un grupo de células vivas no representan a un ser humano"|date=13 June 2018 |url=http://misionesonline.net/2018/06/13/aborto-legal-experto-divulgacion-cientifica-afirma-grupo-celulas-vivas-no-representan-humano/|publisher=Misiones Online|accessdate=23 June 2018}}</ref>

==Prizes==
In 2003, he received the [[Bernardo Houssay Award|Bernardo Houssay Young Researcher Award]], and in 2012, he was a recipient of the Houssay Award.<ref>{{Cite journal |url=http://www4.hcdn.gov.ar/dependencias/dcomisiones/periodo-122/122-1256.pdf |title=Comision de ciencia y tecnologia |journal=Sesiones Ordinarias |number=1256 |publisher=[[Argentine Chamber of Deputies]] |pages=1–8 |language=Spanish |year=2004 |access-date=2020-04-24}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cedi.org.ar/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=293:ejemplo-de-articulo-3&catid=84:investigaciones&Itemid=139 |title=Listado Premios Bernardo Houssay |publisher=CEDIQUIFA |language=Spanish |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150410115339/http://www.cedi.org.ar/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=293:ejemplo-de-articulo-3&catid=84:investigaciones&Itemid=139 |archive-date=2015-04-10 |url-status=dead |access-date=2020-04-24}}</ref>

Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik felicitated UNESCO [[Kalinga Prize]] winner 2015 Prof. Diego Andres Golombek at Odisha state secretariat, presenting him a stole and a silver filigree memento.
